behaviors.source: GH #86 "adds the cost key ... and to its reader src/gate-policy.ts"
behaviors.given: gatePolicy.cost declares cheapThresholdMs, environmentSensitive, cacheEnabled, relatedTests and skipDetectors
behaviors.when: parseGatePolicy parses it and resolveTestCostPlan(cwd) in src/base-gates.ts loads it for a live run
behaviors.then: the typed cost returns with defaults applied, malformed input is refused naming the path, and declaration assembly, resolveCheapGateCatalog, the orchestrator's cache options and the skip-gate declaration each take their part from that one plan with no second policy read
behaviors.observableResult: src/gate-policy.test.ts accepts the full cost object and refuses an unknown sub-key, a non-number cheapThresholdMs, empty patterns and a bad testGlob metacharacter; src/base-gates.test.ts asserts resolveTestCostPlan reads loadGatePolicy(cwd).cost at the src/base-gates.ts:108 site and that a declared environmentSensitive entry changes the declaration resolvePreQAGateDeclarations assembles

behaviors.source: GH #86 "test:budgets is the first declared member"; D16; ADR 0063
behaviors.given: cost.environmentSensitive lists test:budgets, package.json:33 declares the script, and SANITY_STEPS is unchanged so the step is declared outside the sanity plan
behaviors.when: src/base-gates.ts assembles the declarations through resolveScriptStep and a phase runs that gate red
behaviors.then: it carries environmentSensitive true and required false, executes, records its real FAIL, stays out of the repair failure set, consumes no round, is listed as advisory in run-summary.md and the draft PR body, and appears in neither resolveSanityCommands nor resolveCandidateQACommands nor resolveBindableGateCatalog, so a red budget cannot fail the pre-ship gate or candidate QA
behaviors.observableResult: src/base-gates.test.ts asserts the declaration fields, that resolveFullSuiteGateDeclarations appends it after tests, and that resolveSanityPlan(repoRoot) step names stay ["typecheck","lint","tests"] while resolveSanityCommands(repoRoot), resolveCandidateQACommands(repoRoot) and resolveBindableGateCatalog(repoRoot) contain no test:budgets entry; src/post-qa-gates.test.ts asserts decideCandidateGatePhase does not name it; src/logger.test.ts and src/ship-gate.test.ts assert the advisory block lists it; package.json is unmodified

behaviors.source: GH #86 AC "A green gate result on an identical tree ... is reused"; D17
behaviors.given: gate-cache.json holds a PASS keyed by gate ID, resolved command and args, and tree ID, with cacheEnabled true
behaviors.when: runGates reaches that declaration at the same tree ID with the same command and args
behaviors.then: the gate is not spawned, the cached PASS is recorded marked reused, and run-summary.md states the reuse
behaviors.observableResult: src/gate-cache.test.ts and src/gate-runner.test.ts assert no process spawned and the reuse marker; src/logger.test.ts asserts the reuse line

behaviors.source: GH #86 AC "a changed tree or definition invalidates it"; D17
behaviors.given: a cache entry for gate typecheck at tree T
behaviors.when: the gate runs at another tree, with changed command or args, with cacheEnabled false, or against a malformed cache file
behaviors.then: the lookup misses, the gate executes normally, and nothing throws
behaviors.observableResult: src/gate-cache.test.ts covers each miss case and asserts the gate executed; a corrupt file is a miss, not an exception

behaviors.source: GH #86 "verification command is derived from the catalog"; D18; ADR 0038
behaviors.given: the cheap-gate catalog resolved from cost.cheapThresholdMs (default 120000) in src/base-gates.ts, and a --test-command check defined over required cheap gate IDs rather than over the derived command string
behaviors.when: src/orchestrator.ts:6364 calls resolveGeneratorTestCommand with no override, with "pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test:fast", with "pnpm typecheck", and with "pnpm test:fast"
behaviors.then: the derived command is the required cheap gates' commands joined with && in gate order excluding the full-suite tests gate (pnpm run typecheck for this repo), an override covering every required cheap gate is accepted even when it adds segments such as pnpm test:fast, pnpm typecheck normalizes to the same segment as pnpm run typecheck, and an override omitting a required cheap gate refuses the launch naming the omitted gate IDs
behaviors.observableResult: src/orchestrator.test.ts:466's describe block asserts the derived command, the accepted override, the normalization and the refusal naming typecheck; a further assertion reads the --test-command value out of AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, asserts both are the literal "pnpm run typecheck && pnpm test:fast" and that the check accepts it

behaviors.source: GH #86 "detector for newly introduced skip and only forms"; D7
behaviors.given: tests:skipped declared in postQaDeclarations (src/orchestrator.ts:5899-5915) between scopeGateDeclaration and fullSuiteDeclarations, taking ctx.worktreeDir and featBranch from the pair the scope gate uses
behaviors.when: the post-QA phase runs against a candidate adding it.skip to a file matching a detector's testGlobs, a candidate whose only skip was already on the base tree, and a project whose test files match no declared detector
behaviors.then: the gate returns FAIL through GateDeclaration.run and decideCandidateGatePhase returns REPAIR naming it, returns PASS for the pre-existing skip, and fails closed with no matching detector
behaviors.observableResult: src/skip-gate.test.ts asserts the three outcomes and the declaration shape; the four existing spawned assertions at src/qa-orchestration.test.ts:1071, :2281-2287, :2309-2315 and :2432 that assert post-QA gate IDs as ["scope", "tests"] are updated to ["scope", "tests:skipped", "tests"] and are green

behaviors.source: GH #86 AC "never pays for a dependent suite; independent failures still arrive together"; D16, D17
behaviors.given: tests declared with prerequisite typecheck and test:budgets with prerequisite tests, alongside an independent lint declaration
behaviors.then: the dependents are recorded SKIPPED naming the failed prerequisite, lint still executes and reports in the same attempt, and both skips are explicit in evidence and run-summary.md
behaviors.observableResult: src/gate-runner.test.ts asserts the dependent spawned nothing and carries the prerequisite name while the independent gate's result is in the same evidence document; src/logger.test.ts asserts the skip line

behaviors.given: a repo with no afk.config.json, or a gatePolicy with no cost member
behaviors.when: the policy is loaded and the cost plan resolved
behaviors.then: the documented defaults apply and protectedPaths, riskClasses and acceptance behavior is unchanged
behaviors.observableResult: src/gate-policy.test.ts passes unchanged apart from the added cost cases

behaviors.given: resolveSanityPlan as the single source for the sanity command set, with SANITY_STEPS unchanged by this slice
behaviors.when: resolveSanityCommands, resolveCandidateQACommands, projectSanityGateDeclarations and runPreShipSanity read it
behaviors.then: they still agree about which script backs each step, the aggregate pre-ship suite still runs, and no environment-sensitive gate command enters either command list
behaviors.observableResult: existing preship and pre-ship gate assertions stay green, with resolveSanityPlan's step names still ["typecheck", "lint", "tests"] and resolveSanityCommands(repoRoot)/resolveCandidateQACommands(repoRoot) free of test:budgets as asserted in src/base-gates.test.ts

behaviors.given: the pre-QA/post-QA split with the acceptance gate in the pre-QA set
behaviors.then: cheap gates and the acceptance gate run before candidate QA, the full suite runs only after QA accepts that exact tree, and a full-suite failure returns evidence to the next repair round
behaviors.observableResult: the existing spawned pre-QA gate-ID assertions of ["typecheck", "lint"] in src/qa-orchestration.test.ts stay green unchanged

behaviors.then: they return today's answers, and a malformed policy still throws rather than degrading to the derived baseline
behaviors.observableResult: existing acceptance-plan and bindable-catalog assertions stay green after the cost plumbing lands
